notes: Bubble gum note verbatim on Wikiquote (18 words, over the 15 word guide for quotes, but it is the film's signature line). Soup kitchen at the church: IMDb plot summary. Justiceville: Black Gate. Alley fight: IMDb and Black Gate. OBEY, CONSUME, WORK 8 HOURS, SLEEP 8 HOURS, STAY ASLEEP and THIS IS YOUR GOD all on Wikiquote's list. Frank's steel mill line on Wikiquote.

vibe.verdict: A soup kitchen canteen with a timetable of subliminal orders, Cable 54 and the bubble gum line feels right, though the food is plain canteen fare.
